indicators.label: CPI inflation
indicators.scoring_rule: The figure the publisher prints (MoSPI/NSO, via the portal's indicator series), not a figure derived here. RBI flexible target 4% +/- 2% (2-6%). Green 2-4.5, watch 1.5-2 / 4.5-6, red <1.5 or >6. The chart draws the longer index-derived history, reconciled against this series to within 0.1pp (see cross_checks).
indicators.status_reason: 5.54% - inside the band but above target (an index-derived y-o-y for the same month gives 5.59%; the two differ because the published index is rounded to one decimal)

indicators.label: WPI inflation
indicators.scoring_rule: No formal target. Green 0-3, watch <0 or 3-6, red >6.
indicators.status_reason: 11.39% - high wholesale inflation. Caveat: the series carries an unusual +4% month-on-month step in Apr-2026 (both index bases show it), so treat the level as provisional.
